Explain the quadratic formula with a table.

ChatGPT said:
Here is the breakdown.

The roots of $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$ are

$$
x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}
$$

| Term | Meaning | Example |
|:---|:---:|---:|
| $a$ | leading coefficient | 2 |
| $b$ | linear coefficient<br>second line | -3 |
| `c` | constant | 1 |

1. Compute the discriminant $\Delta = b^2 - 4ac$.
   - If $\Delta > 0$: two roots
   - If $\Delta = 0$: one root
2. Apply the formula.[^1]

> [!NOTE]
> Prices are examples only, costs $5 and $10.
